summary: Result group scrolling now behaves more naturally for short groups while preserving internal scrolling for long result sets.
evidence: Short groups are less likely to hit the internal max-height threshold after increasing viewport allowance
Nested scroll friction reduced with overscroll-behavior containment
Mobile result groups use page scrolling instead of internal group scrolling
knownLimitations: Long desktop result groups still scroll internally by design to keep multiple requested-card groups usable.
